primary_chain_dispositions.rationale: Repair the lost action-relevant history and finite-area contact distinctions, without presupposing whether their best inductive bias is physical, learned, or hybrid.
The performance choice and the applied action must be one relation containing physical, energy, actuator and deadline authority.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Calibration-fixed or memoryless point models alias histories and finite-area contacts that imply different future wrench, slip, contact-loss and impedance decisions.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Represent the smallest safely observable history whose action-conditional outcome set preserves robust impedance feasibility and ranking, and adapt that set after an admitted calibration-out change rather than only detecting or rejecting it.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM fixed point-contact prediction TO support-indexed adaptive decision-sufficient contact outcomes
required_mechanism_changes.causal_position: Between observation history and impedance selection
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Material, geometry, sliding condition or contact history changes future capacity or the preferred feasible impedance
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The controller needs distinctions that alter its decision, not a generally complete contact digital twin.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: A performance gain is proposed before contact, energy, actuator, infeasibility and deadline checks, so the intended and applied actions diverge or no timely action exists.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Map every update state to either a jointly feasible normal-tangential impedance or a declared feasible withdrawal action in one total relation.
required_mechanism_changes.change_direction: FROM proposal-then-correction TO constraint-internalized total applied action
required_mechanism_changes.activation_condition: Uncertainty, hard margins or computation availability becomes active
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The relation remains meaningful under optimization success, infeasibility, support loss and timeout.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Predict action-conditional force, path, slip/contact-loss, energy and actuator margins from safely observable history.
acceptance_conditions: Every retained state family changes robust feasible actions or their ranking on held-out decisions.

required_capabilities.required_capability: After support loss inside a declared envelope, update the outcome relation and recover useful decision ordering while never relaxing independently valid envelope margins.
acceptance_conditions: Logged in-envelope changes cause valid prediction and action-ranking recovery; outside-envelope cases withdraw.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Choose contact-frame normal and tangential stiffness/damping only from actions satisfying contact, wrench, energy, actuator and gain-rate limits.
acceptance_conditions: No downstream guard changes an action called feasible.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Publish a relation member at every deadline.
acceptance_conditions: Every compute and support outcome has an on-time logged feasible scan or withdrawal action.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Define history equivalence over the impedance decision class and discard prediction detail that does not change feasible actions or ranking.
acceptance_conditions: Nested ablation finds the smallest state within a predeclared decision-regret tolerance.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Separate supported calibration, in-envelope set adaptation and outside-envelope withdrawal; an adaptive posterior may shape cost or further restrict actions but cannot relax the envelope authority.
acceptance_conditions: No arbitrary-shift guarantee; support, containment, contraction and withdrawal are separately auditable.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Apply every hard margin, including accumulated interaction energy, to the same gain sequence optimized for task performance.
acceptance_conditions: Penalties are not called limits and post-hoc projection is excluded from the claim.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Register a rate- and actuator-feasible unloading action before optimization and atomically publish only verified relation members.
acceptance_conditions: Forced interruption affects cost, not action existence or declared feasibility.

target_mechanism_signatures.domain_neutral_failure_structure: Observation histories with different future constrained decisions are aliased and an admitted distribution change is only detected.
target_mechanism_signatures.causal_or_computational_variable_or_rela: History and candidate gain to bounded future outcome and action order
target_mechanism_signatures.current_relation_or_state: Fixed point law or unsupported point extrapolation
target_mechanism_signatures.required_intervention: Decision-sufficient causal outcome state with authority-correct online set adaptation
target_mechanism_signatures.change_direction: FROM fixed point-contact prediction TO support-indexed adaptive decision-sufficient contact outcomes
target_mechanism_signatures.causal_position: Between observation history and impedance selection
target_mechanism_signatures.activation_condition: Material, geometry, sliding condition or contact history changes future capacity or the preferred feasible impedance

target_mechanism_signatures.domain_neutral_failure_structure: The optimized action can later be changed or become unavailable.
target_mechanism_signatures.causal_or_computational_variable_or_rela: Outcome uncertainty, hard margins, deadline and applied action
target_mechanism_signatures.current_relation_or_state: Performance proposal plus external guard or timeout
target_mechanism_signatures.change_direction: FROM proposal-then-correction TO constraint-internalized total applied action

premises: Only contact distinctions that change feasible actions or ranking are necessary.
Calibration-out adaptation must change the predictive relation, not merely flag it.
derivation_steps: Define action equivalence over the four-gain decision class.
Predict the smallest multistep outcome vector needed by cost and constraints.
Use calibrated authority on support, a containing adaptive envelope set after in-envelope support loss, and withdrawal outside it.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: It preserves precisely the distinctions and uncertainty semantics used by impedance selection.
assumptions: A declared adaptation envelope contains the target shifts.
The outcome state is observable enough to update.
boundaries: No material identification or arbitrary-shift claim.

premises: A hard limit constrains the rendered action.
A robot needs an action at every deadline.
derivation_steps: Form robust feasibility over predicted outcomes and accumulated energy.
Union verified scan actions with a preverified unloading member and publish atomically by deadline.
first_principles.derived_intervention: Constraint-internalized total normal-tangential impedance action relation.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: Selected and applied actions cannot diverge and timeout does not make the relation partial.
assumptions: The admitted operating envelope contains a feasible unloading action.
boundaries: Solver and incumbent data structure are implementation choices.

representation_transformations.new_representation: Finite-area viscoelastic normal state plus tangential pre-slip/friction-capacity state with bounded parameters
representation_transformations.failure_mechanism_resolution: Adds geometry, fading memory and coupled tangential capacity only where they affect impedance decisions.
assumptions: The chosen constitutive family contains admitted contacts.
boundaries: No claim beyond its bounded family.

representation_transformations.new_representation: Stable causal structured outcome state with bounded adaptable low-dimensional coefficients
representation_transformations.failure_mechanism_resolution: Learns history and finite-area outcome sufficiency without requiring a correct constitutive decomposition.
assumptions: Structural output constraints and bounded adaptation control extrapolation.
boundaries: GRU, TCN and state-space realization are not scientific commitments.

representation_transformations.old_representation: Either a closed physical law or unconstrained learned predictor
representation_transformations.new_representation: Finite-area fading-memory skeleton plus bounded causal decision residual
representation_transformations.failure_mechanism_resolution: Retains physical support and dissipation while allowing systematic decision-relevant mismatch.
representation_transformations.information_preserved: Physical capacity structure and learned residual history
assumptions: Residual complexity is smaller than full learned dynamics.
boundaries: Evidence-informed target derivation; no Source-migration claim.

representation_transformations.old_representation: Nominal performance gain followed by external guard, correction or timeout handling
representation_transformations.new_representation: A total applied-action set containing robustly verified scan actions and a preverified withdrawal member
representation_transformations.failure_mechanism_resolution: The quantities optimized and constrained refer to the same rendered gain, and every deadline has a relation member.
representation_transformations.information_preserved: Performance ordering, hard-margin authority and compute outcome
assumptions: Withdrawal is feasible throughout the admitted envelope.
boundaries: No claim that a specific optimizer or barrier is necessary.

discovery_executions.closure_rationale: Recovered representation- and loss-level decision-sufficiency mechanisms.

domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: Retain distinctions because they change downstream decisions.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Histories mix decision-irrelevant detail with decision-changing aliases.

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Robust constrained control, runtime assurance and anytime feasible optimization
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: These communities make uncertain limits and backup availability part of action feasibility.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Actions fail when constraints or computation are checked after optimization.
domain_hypotheses.expected_intervention_family: Feasible incumbents or certificate-defined admissible action sets
domain_hypotheses.closure_rationale: R11 retains the simpler total scan/withdraw relation.

domain_hypotheses.domain_or_research_community_or_paradigm: Value-equivalent modeling in model-based reinforcement learning
domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: Model distinctions are necessary only when scoped values or policies change.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Detailed predictive models waste capacity on irrelevant distinctions.

domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: Errors are weighted by downstream regret.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Accurate parameters can induce poor optimized decisions.

domain_hypotheses.structural_rationale: Context-conditioned uncertainty can be calibrated through decisions it induces.
domain_hypotheses.expected_problem_structure: Point uncertainty representations misalign risk and decisions.

search_space_closures.closure_rationale: Evidence closes the required relation but not the best representation bias; preserve all three rather than invent uniqueness.
The RMC fixes totality and hard-limit internalization; solver brand, exact horizon and set representation do not survive the removal test as scientific mechanisms.

principle_search_record.closure_rationale: R11 closes the common RMC-required relation and explicitly leaves only the representation inductive bias underconstrained. Exact recurrent architecture, estimator geometry, optimizer, information bonus and numerical horizon are implementation freedoms.

solution_space_constraint_assessment.constraint_basis: Accepted RMCs require decision-sufficient adaptive outcomes and a total constrained action relation, but present Evidence does not eliminate a bounded finite-area physical family, a structurally constrained learned family, or their residual hybrid independently of the planned empirical comparison.

candidate_principles.principle: A bounded finite-area viscoelastic/pre-slip contact state is adapted online and consumed by one robust scan-or-withdraw normal-tangential impedance relation.
activation_conditions: The admitted contact family is expressible by a bounded finite-area physical parameter set.
Contact memory or tangential capacity changes the gain decision.
candidate_principles.intervention: Estimate a containing set of finite-area normal relaxation and tangential pre-slip/capacity parameters; propagate candidate four-gain sequences through it; choose only robustly feasible sequences or publish the registered withdrawal.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Trial-fixed scalar environment parameter becomes an online containing constitutive state directly inside constrained gain choice.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: History and geometry alter the parameter state and predicted capacities; every applied action is selected against the same physical, energy, actuator and deadline relation.
failure_conditions: Systematic decision-relevant residual remains after bounded parameter adaptation.
A simpler memoryless law is action-equivalent.
The total action set is empty in an admitted state.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: The finite-area viscoelastic/pre-slip family contains admitted contacts with a nonvacuous bounded parameter set.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject physical-only and use a learned or hybrid candidate.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Passive scan observations contract the decision-relevant parameter set before the change loses relevance.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The candidate cannot solve calibration-out adaptation rather than refusal.

target_domain_operationalization: Use nonnegative Prony/Maxwell normal modes with geometry-dependent finite-area indentation and a bounded pre-slip/bristle state with friction and moment capacity.
Update the containing parameter set by drift propagation and action-outcome consistency; the nominal center shapes cost, while all envelope members constrain actions.
Optimize a short horizon of a=(log k_n,log d_n,log k_t,log d_t); choose the horizon from the shortest measured memory/energy interval that changes the current action, allowing H=1 if equivalent.
Constrain wrench, slip/contact retention, energy balance, joint/actuator and gain/rate margins; atomically publish a verified scan action or rate-limited unload.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: Known physical contact and MPVIC precedents do not make a bounded finite-area history state adapt online to held-out scan changes and directly govern a total four-gain outcome relation.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: Move physical contact uncertainty from pre-identification into action-conditional robust gain selection with support-indexed adaptation.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Test whether a minimal interpretable contact family suffices for out-of-calibration joint scan decisions without learned dynamics.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: An interpretable adaptive finite-area contact capacity relation, not a neural replacement of HC.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: This is the strongest simple alternative to learned contact: it attributes all required memory and cross-axis capacity to a bounded physical family.

predictions.observable: Matched-budget active-margin error and selected-action regret
predictions.pattern_a: Physical-only matches the hybrid feasible set and action ordering with lower data need.
predictions.pattern_b: A systematic history- or geometry-dependent residual changes feasible actions after parameter adaptation.
predictions.activation_condition: Paired episodes differ in admitted material, geometry or history.
predictions.killer_criterion: Persistent decision-relevant residual outside the containing family kills physical-only.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Counterfactual replay isolates representation before controller trials.

predictions.observable: Set containment, contraction and action-regret recovery after support loss
predictions.pattern_a: Passive observations contract the set and improve valid action ordering before relevance expires.
predictions.pattern_b: The set remains vacuous so fixed conservative impedance is equivalent.
predictions.killer_criterion: Detection without valid decision recovery kills adaptation.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Logged replay directly separates adaptation from refusal.

predictions.observable: Applied-action membership under active energy, infeasibility and forced timeout
predictions.pattern_a: Every action is a verified robust scan member or registered withdrawal by deadline.
predictions.pattern_b: A post-hoc guard realizes the same action, or the claimed relation publishes a nonmember.
predictions.activation_condition: A hard margin or timeout is active.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any downstream action change or missing deadline member kills totality.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Trace audit is decisive without broad performance testing.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Viable strongest simple route; its top-venue strength depends on physical-family sufficiency and separation from adaptive MPVIC.

candidate_principles.principle: A structurally constrained causal outcome state with bounded online adaptation drives one robust scan-or-withdraw normal-tangential impedance relation.
activation_conditions: Decision-relevant contact variation is not contained by a useful low-order physical family.
A bounded structured recurrent state is learnable from the declared data.
candidate_principles.intervention: Learn a stable causal action-conditioned outcome state under contact/dissipation structure, adapt only a bounded low-dimensional coefficient set online, and consume its supported or envelope outcome tube in the total gain relation.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Named environment parameters are replaced by the smallest directly decision-trained causal state; the uncertainty object rather than a point network output authorizes action.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The learned state retains material-, geometry-, sliding- and history-dependent distinctions that change decisions, while bounded authority and totality prevent unsupported predictions from authorizing unsafe gains.
failure_conditions: The learned state cannot be calibrated or adapted with containment.
Architecture detail rather than outcome sufficiency drives gains.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A low-dimensional stable causal state can preserve the required action-conditional outcomes over the declared envelope.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject learned-only or narrow the envelope.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Online adaptation of a bounded coefficient/latent set recovers decision ordering without violating structural margins.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The learned route only detects shift and fails the problem.

target_domain_operationalization: Train a stable causal state-space, GRU or TCN realization on multistep force/path/contact/slip/energy/actuator outcomes and constrained decision regret; architecture remains free.
Hard-parameterize no-contact zero wrench, compressive normal force and dissipative/friction-capacity output support; calibrate simultaneous one-sided controller-consumed margins.
After in-envelope support loss, propagate and intersect a bounded adaptable last-layer/latent set with observations; use its center for cost and every containing member for constraints.
Use the same four-gain short-horizon robust optimization and scan-or-withdraw publication relation as the other candidates.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: Deep MPVIC learns an interaction model for impedance MPC but does not establish support-indexed in-contact bounded adaptation and total normal-tangential outcome authority under held-out contact shifts.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: Train the causal state for constrained decision sufficiency and make its adaptive outcome set, not its mean, govern action.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Determine whether structured learned memory is sufficient and necessary for out-of-calibration coupled scan decisions.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: A decision-trained, authority-correct learned contact state rather than a generic neural dynamics model.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Unlike the physical candidate it does not require a correct constitutive decomposition; unlike the hybrid candidate it does not reserve a physical nominal skeleton.

predictions.observable: Matched-budget feasible-set error, data need and action regret
predictions.pattern_a: Structured learned state captures residual history distinctions that physical-only misses and remains calibrated.
predictions.pattern_b: Physical-only is action-equivalent with lower data and uncertainty.
predictions.killer_criterion: Action equivalence of physical-only kills the learned core as unnecessary.

predictions.observable: Margin validity and decision recovery per sample
predictions.pattern_a: Learned-only adapts as reliably as hybrid without residual decomposition.
predictions.pattern_b: Physical structure materially reduces data or prevents invalid margins.
predictions.activation_condition: Calibration-out shift remains inside the common envelope.
predictions.killer_criterion: Failure of containment or inferior decision recovery under matched capacity kills learned-only.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Common logged shifts compare adaptation directly.

predictions.observable: Applied-action membership under active margins and interruption
predictions.pattern_a: The learned mean may change cost but cannot authorize a nonrobust action; withdrawal arrives by deadline.
predictions.pattern_b: A separated guard is action-equivalent or changes the selected gain.
predictions.activation_condition: Uncertainty, energy or timeout is active.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any posterior relaxation of envelope authority or post-hoc action change kills the relation.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Viable when constitutive mismatch is decision-relevant and structured bounded learning is data-feasible.

candidate_principles.principle: A finite-area fading-memory contact skeleton plus bounded causal decision residual adapts online and drives one robust scan-or-withdraw normal-tangential impedance relation.
activation_conditions: Physical-only leaves systematic decision-relevant residual and learned-only loses useful physical support or sample efficiency.
candidate_principles.intervention: Propagate a bounded finite-area physical state and a bounded causal residual state jointly; calibrate or adapt their summed outcome set; consume it in the same total gain relation.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Physical contact is retained as a constraint-compatible nominal relation while learning is restricted to the missing decision-relevant outcome residual.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: The physical part preserves geometry, memory and capacity structure; the residual repairs model-form aliasing; the common set and total action relation connect both directly to the applied impedance.
failure_conditions: Either physical-only or learned-only is action-equivalent.
Residual uncertainty is no smaller or more adaptable than full learned uncertainty.
The summed set invalidates hard margins.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: The physical skeleton removes stable structure while a lower-complexity residual captures remaining decision distinctions.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Hybrid complexity is unnecessary; select the dominating simpler candidate.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Physical and residual uncertainty compose into a containing, computationally usable outcome set.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: The hybrid cannot authorize constrained actions.

target_domain_operationalization: Use the physical candidate's finite-area relaxation/pre-slip state as the nominal outcome map.
Learn only bounded multistep corrections to controller-consumed outcomes and active margins, with no claim that GRU/TCN is necessary.
Adapt the joint parameter/residual set after in-envelope support loss; posterior centers affect cost and containing sets constrain actions.
Apply the common four-gain short-horizon robust objective, energy state and scan-or-withdraw publication relation.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: Current physical and learned MPVIC precedents do not couple a finite-area memory skeleton, bounded online decision residual, support-indexed authority and total four-gain scan relation.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: Use physics to define support and learned residual only to repair decision-relevant model error, with both uncertainties inside optimization.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Test whether complementary physical and learned structure is the minimal route to valid, adaptive out-of-calibration scan decisions.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: A complementary physics-residual decision model whose uncertainty authority changes with support and directly controls total constrained impedance.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Hybrid is retained conditionally, not declared uniquely necessary: it must beat both simpler representation classes on decision error, validity or data efficiency.

predictions.pattern_a: Hybrid removes systematic residual that changes feasible actions.
predictions.activation_condition: Admitted shifts expose physical model mismatch.
predictions.killer_criterion: Physical-only equivalence kills the residual mechanism.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Matched replay provides the earliest discriminator.

predictions.observable: Data need, containing-set width and decision recovery
predictions.pattern_a: Hybrid attains valid tighter outcome sets or faster recovery than learned-only.
predictions.pattern_b: Learned-only matches or dominates without decomposition.
predictions.activation_condition: Common held-out contact shifts and compute budgets.
predictions.killer_criterion: No validity, regret or sample-efficiency benefit kills hybrid complexity.

predictions.observable: Hard-margin and deadline membership of every applied action
predictions.pattern_a: Summed uncertainty remains inside the total relation and timeout publishes withdrawal.
predictions.pattern_b: Composition needs a later guard or yields no timely member.
predictions.activation_condition: Residual, energy or computation margins are active.
predictions.killer_criterion: Any external correction or absent member kills totality.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Viable only if complementarity is demonstrated against both simpler candidates; R11 no longer treats it as the predetermined answer.
